contract.effective: selected target geometry: own loaded facing distal pad at a higher fret on the target string or an unauthorized string/fret, or another finger at a higher fret on the target string; penalties only on audible overlap
contract.own: same-string higher distal pad blocks even with positive assigned pad or simultaneous authorization; otherwise positive assigned pad takes precedence over incidental own samples and simultaneous active selected own target cells are authorized
contract.other: full thumb/finger2/3 loaded virtual-string samples; same/lower fret is not wrong; higher blocks even with positive assigned pad
contract.pad_geometry: finite unique nearest press-plane string within3mm, signed height[-1,3]mm, facing cosine>=0.1, distal netload>=0.01N, fret interior inset2mm
contract.times: raw geometry at both physics endpoints, integrated over clipped audible overlap; no time-mask before trapezoid; overlapping sources do not multiply penalty
contract.confidence: only unambiguous fret interiors contribute; no inferred wrong from unloaded/absent contact
contract.source_fret_range: inclusive min/max contributing source fret per target/body; read only where source time>0
contract.next_preparation: matches future scoped own finger/string/fret in press-2..onset; diagnostic only, never exempts current interference
contract.scope: GPU left finger-skill only; net body force cannot identify contact partner, calibrated pressure or sound
